biography: My name is Yelyzaveta Danchenko, and I present my work under the creative pseudonym “kemuna”. I am a graphic designer and 2D artist specializing in digital illustration and visual design. I especially enjoy creating characters and turning ideas into expressive visual concepts.

I have experience creating advertising materials, following established brand guidelines, preparing artwork for print, adapting designs to multiple formats, and producing 2D assets for games. This portfolio showcases both my creative skills and professional experience. I am open to full-time opportunities that would allow me to continue growing as an artist and designer.
